text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Ardan, Chiyono O. Allow me to express my
gratitude for your
cooperation, despite
your busy schedules.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Oh, if anything, it is my honor to receive
an invitation from you. I'll
make every
endeavor to aid you today.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Same here! I'm sure that the progress you
make here will teach me a
lot too!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's been a little while since we started
practicing race strategies to
balance the
blaze fierce and water still.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Today, we're putting the forms to the test
in a run with Mejiro Ardan and Sakura
Chiyono O, who both debuted around the
same time as
Yaeno Muteki.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for all your sound advice thus
far, Trainer. In this race... I
will show you
the fruit of our lessons!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Pant... Pant...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mid-race, Sakura Chiyono O has the lead.
The old Yaeno Muteki
would've rushed to
the challenge, but...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
(...First, one must account for their lap
time.)

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
(I've committed the appropriate speed and
pacing to muscle memory.
I'll not let
others distract me—and I'll maintain my
ideal form!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Pant... Pant...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Hah!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Ardan makes a move to get into a
good position at the corner,
but Yaeno
Muteki calmly reads the situation and
blocks her.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
(Second, one must study their opponent
and anticipate the events of
a race before
running it.)

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
...As expected,
Ardan is extremely skilled.
Even her most minute actions are 
calculated to cover for her physical
weaknesses, and she executes them 
without haste or hesitation.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
(I must visualize how she'll perform,
examine every possibility... and
then
formulate my response to each.)

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: And now—

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Haaah!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
(All that's left is to let the blaze burn!
And burn! And BURN! There's
no need to fear
it—just let it combust like an engine,
rocketing me straight to my goal!)

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
(I won't surrender the lead—not to anyone!
This victory... will be
MINE!)

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: AAAAAAH!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Yaeno Muteki makes an impressive spurt,
surging across the finish line
first.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Pant... Pant...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Blaze fierce and water still...
I've balanced
them both!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Yaeno. That was most impressive.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Ah! ...Pardon my rudeness, shouting like
that before expressing my
gratitude for
the run.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: No worries! You were so... so cool just now! I think that was the most intense running I've ever seen from you!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Agreed. Intense, yes... and deeply
frightening to witness as a rival. It
seems
our generation has much to fear.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Now then. Chiyono O, shall the two of us
be off? I believe a
reflection is in order, to
ensure we don't lose to Yaeno again.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, count me in!
You better watch out
next time, Yaeno!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
...They make good points. I cannot bear to
lose real races either. I'll
need to reflect on
this run to seize victory in the Twinkle
Series.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: (And to that end...)

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer. Perfect timing.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Would you accompany me for a bit?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I follow Yaeno Muteki, who leads me to
the riverbank where we first
met. She turns
to me, and then...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Do you remember the Kongo Yaegaki
katas you studied before?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Excellent. With those forms in mind... I
would like you to spar with
me, please.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: ...Whenever you're ready.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I hurriedly get into stance, and—

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Hah! Sei!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Hup! TAAAH!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The exchange is far from a proper sparring
bout. My motions are
weak and hesitant,
without the sharp, fluid energy Yaeno
Muteki has.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
But even so... as we trade blows,
I start to
feel a connection with
her—an unspoken
understanding I can't quite explain.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Thank you for the bout!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Did, um...
Did you feel what I was trying to
show you?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I don't know how else to articulate it,
but I
tried to demonstrate
through each strike
and each catch...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I trust you unwaveringly.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Your teachings led me to the balance of
blaze fierce and water still.
For future
lessons, I would like to officially become
your pupil.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Trainer. As master and apprentice... I am
eager to study more about
racing under
your tutelage!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And with that, I'm named Yaeno's official
trainer for the Twinkle
Series!
